card.name: Non- and un- starting hyphenated drug terms
card.fires_on: The negative pole responds to the prefix "non" (or "un") and nearby word parts, mostly right before a hyphen or an adjective like -randomized, -preserved or -replicating. It also fires on a few other word parts in hyphenated compounds.

modes.label: non- before a term
modes.description: The word "non" starts a hyphenated or compound descriptor, often in study design or product handling text.

modes.label: Other compound pieces
modes.description: Odd word parts inside hyphenated or compound modifiers, such as "-center" or "nd" in an ordinal.
modes.example: with the following non<<-center>> post NLADs: Alaris SMART

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens suggest no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on "non" and similar negating word starts that lead into a hyphenated descriptor.
